map.→ 打开绝对湿度 AH工具: -> Open the Absolute Humidity AH tool
map.为什么冬天开暖气更干？: Why Is It Drier When the Heating Is On in Winter?
map.对比冬夏同湿度下的绝对湿度差异解释「湿冷/湿热」。: Compare the absolute humidity difference between winter and summer at the same relative humidity to explain "damp cold / damp heat".
map.已知气温与相对湿度，算单位体积空气含多少克水汽。: Given the air temperature and the relative humidity, compute how many grams of water vapour are in a unit volume of air.
map.暖气升温但水汽量不变，绝对湿度不变、相对湿度骤降，体感燥，需加湿而非只升温。: Heating raises the temperature while the amount of water vapour is unchanged, so the absolute humidity stays the same and the relative humidity drops sharply, making it feel dry; humidification is needed rather than heating alone.
map.温室/仓储控湿时由绝对湿度定除湿量。: In greenhouses and warehouses, the dehumidification load is determined from the absolute humidity.
map.由气温与相对湿度，按经验式计算单位体积空气中的水蒸气质量（g/m³）。: From the air temperature and relative humidity, compute the mass of water vapour per unit volume of air (g/m³) with an empirical formula.
map.相对湿度是「离饱和有多近」的百分比，绝对湿度是「实际有多少克水汽」；温度一变，相: Relative humidity is the percentage of "how close to saturation", while absolute humidity is "how many grams of water vapour there actually are"; when the temperature changes the relative humidity changes a lot while the absolute humidity stays relatively stable.
map.绝对湿度和相对湿度区别？: What Is the Difference Between Absolute and Relative Humidity?
map.：25°C、相对湿度 60%：饱和水汽压≈31.7 hPa，实际水汽压=31.7: : at 25 °C and 60% relative humidity the saturation vapour pressure is ≈31.7 hPa and the actual vapour pressure = 31.7×0.6 ≈ 19.0 hPa; the absolute humidity = 216.7×19.0/(25+273.15) ≈ 13.8 g/m³.
map.：5°C、相对湿度 60%：饱和压≈8.7 hPa，实际≈5.2 hPa，绝对湿: : at 5 °C and 60% relative humidity the saturation pressure is ≈8.7 hPa and the actual ≈5.2 hPa, giving an absolute humidity of ≈4.4 g/m³, far below the summer 13.8, which is why winter feels dry.
